summary: MJC Partners is a Top 100 accounting firm in Dandenong and St Kilda Road, Melbourne, led by Director and CEO Chris Simmons. It completed its first full year after merging with Deanne Thomas & Co (July 2026 message), runs a separate bookkeeping arm that is changing leadership, and Chris has spoken publicly about improving processes and systems and growing by acquisition.

hooks.text: Post-merger integration of Deanne Thomas & Co clients onto MJC's processes; Chris says the firm focuses on processes and systems.
MJC Bookkeeping Solutions leadership handover (new Practice Manager) is a natural point to revisit reconciliation workflow.
Stated appetite for further mergers and acquisitions means onboarding more client books.

risks.text: Recent merger and bookkeeping leadership transition could mean change fatigue or tooling decisions already in flight.
Chris appeared on MYOB's Fiscal Therapy podcast, so the firm may be MYOB-aligned; stack not confirmed.
Headcount figures differ across sources (30+ on the website, 50+ in the 2025 welcome letter); Bryan James has no email on file.

gaps: No MJC job ads found in this sweep.
No posts by Chris Simmons surfaced on LinkedIn in the last 12 months via search.
Tech stack (Xero vs MYOB) not confirmed.
